name: The Forest Remembers
introDiscord:
The oldest kelp no longer whispers random words.

It remembers scenes.

Faint images move through the leaves: travelers resting, creatures
passing, storms long gone, and somewhere among them, a white-haired elf
and a tiny Moon Sprite wandering these same paths.
introTwitch:
The oldest kelp no longer whispers random words.

It remembers scenes.

Faint images move through the leaves: travelers resting, creatures
passing, storms long gone, and somewhere among them, a white-haired elf
and a tiny Moon Sprite wandering these same paths.

the-forest-remembers-approach.prompt:
Three rootways pass through curtains of memory-kelp. Each leaf briefly
shows something that happened here years before.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp folds around a Star Candy cache.

When you reach for it, the nearby leaves replay Shizuki finding the same
hiding place.

She looks delighted.

Then immediately forgets where she put it.

right.message:
A Memory-Kelp Oracle glides between the leaves.

Around it, old images of the forest overlap until past and present become
difficult to separate.

Then the Oracle turns toward you.

forward.message:
Fresh restorative sap rests beneath a memory of Shizuki treating an old
injury in the same spot.

Her later note reads:

'Came back.

Pool still here.

I was less lost this time.

Technically.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative sap untouched. The memory fades, but the pool
remains.

the-forest-remembers-depths.prompt:
Moonlit fronds display longer memories now. Three paths wind through
scenes from different years layered over one another.

left.message:
A Memory-Kelp Oracle passes through an image of Shizuki laughing with
Glimmer.

The memory scatters into green light.

The Oracle emerges from it.

right.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer contains Star Candies.

The surrounding kelp remembers dozens of travelers finding the same
shrine across generations.

forward.message:
"One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's newest note:

'Forest remembered me.

Not Subject Seven.

Not escaped experiment.

Me.

I think I like this place.'"

No joke after this line.

the-forest-remembers-threshold.prompt:
Towering kelp parts around Recollection Grove. Three final paths pass
through memories of Murmurleaf Paths, the lanternvines, the moonblossom
garden, the auroras of old Fae lights, and countless travelers who came
before.

left.message:
A moonblossom pool reflects Shizuki and Glimmer sitting beside it years
ago.

Her note reads:

'If you made it this far, rest.

The forest isn't going anywhere.

Probably.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the pool untouched. The old image of Shizuki and Glimmer
fades gently from the water.

right.message:
A Memory-Kelp Oracle waits among overlapping scenes of the forest.

Every memory goes still when it notices you.

forward.message:
An offering basket rests at the center of several remembered journeys.
Inside are Star Candies beneath a simple carving:

'For whoever comes next.'

boss-antechamber.name: Recollection Grove
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every memory in the Grove turns toward the same ancient kelp tree.

bossPromptDiscord:
Recollection Grove fills with scenes from across Whispering Kelp
Forest.

The Murmurleaf whispers.

Lanternvines glow.

Moonmoths drift.

The ancient roots rise.

Then all of the memories gather around one figure standing quietly
beneath the oldest leaves.

Use /yes to approach the Keeper of the Grove or /no to leave the forest's
memories undisturbed.

bossRetreatText:
You step away from Recollection Grove. The memories slowly return to
their leaves.

boss.revealText:
Green light gathers around an ancient Oracle as countless remembered
scenes orbit its body.

Keeper of Green Memories reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Keeper returns to the oldest kelp.

The memories settle.

But before the final image fades, the forest shows Shizuki and Glimmer
leaving through a part of the grove that looks nothing like the ancient
roots around it.

Straight walls.

Artificial light.

A pursuit marker half-buried beneath moss.

Something else has been hiding inside the forest."
